entries.effect: You feel a distinct sense of being watched or pried into. You know the general direction of the diviner (if within 100 meters) and the domain being probed (identity, location, secrets, etc.).
You sense the diviner's approximate Sequence (±1) and their general Pathway family. You may attempt to trace the connection back to its source (Quick Contest of your SPI vs the diviner's SPI).

You gain a clear vision of the diviner's face and surroundings. You may attempt to feed a false image or piece of information back through the connection — make a Ritualistic Magic or Acting roll contested by the diviner's SPI. On success, they receive your false information as genuine.
You feel nothing unusual. The divination proceeds unnoticed.
You sense nothing, and the diviner is aware that you could have detected them — they know you failed to notice.
